title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 03 June 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 02 June 2026 Increase in rainfall over the southwestern parts of the island and, increase in wind speed across the island are expected from tomorrow (03) and during the next few days. Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times across the island. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
